title: 18F-FDG PET/CT-based Prognostic Model for Predicting Outcome in Patients With Peripheral T-cell Lymphoma
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate whether 18F-FDG PET/CT-based prognostic model of PTCL can predict disease progression
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* newly diagnosed PTCL
* treated using an anthracycline-containing regimen
* minimal follow-up at 6 months after the completion of first-line treatment
* complete medical history and clinicopathological data

Exclusion Criteria:

* secondary malignant disease
* serious infection or inflammation (e.g., HIV)
* primary central nervous system lymphoma
* hepatic or renal dysfunction.
